values.name: interception
values.value: inject monitor_hook.dll into a 64-bit target process, patch kernel32 CreateFileW/CreateFileA/ReadFile/WriteFile/CloseHandle/GetProcAddress/GetOverlappedResult(Ex) IATs, substitute hooked addresses in GetProcAddress results for late .NET P/Invoke binders, preserve the thread last error in every hook, capture overlapped writes at call time and overlapped reads via OVERLAPPED-status watcher threads, stream COM opens/RX/TX to \\.\pipe\monitor_capture, route into capture sessions
values.source: substitution for decompiled kernel chain: sub_a874f0 service install, sub_a8b020 driver deploy, sub_a89f70 open \\.\ComDrv12x/ParDrv3x, sub_a89d60 ioctl kind+0x880, sub_a89bd0 pump, sub_a893e0 decode; implemented in src/inject.rs + hook/src/lib.rs, verified by --inject-smoke and --inject-comtest COM1 COM2 (tx PING123 + rx ECHO123 through a .NET SerialPort runtime binder)
